meta.title: Recreate Order: Create Order with non‑numeric characters in quantity field is rejected

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event's summary page.
Open the Recreate Order window from the event Settings menu.

args.goal: in the Recreate Order window, click Edit More Details, enter abc in the Quantity Requested* field, click Create Order, and stop when the screen proves the non-numeric quantity was rejected

steps.note: Perform the detailed buyer-side form interaction that has no dedicated catalog step.
Assert that creating the order was refused with an application error.
